name: migrate-to-nuxt
description: Faithful-then-idiomatic migration of Next.js (React) frontends and Express/Node/Flask/FastAPI backends into a full Nuxt 4 app. Strangler-fig backend ports gated on recorded contract fixtures, plan files for multi-session work, three entry modes (including backend-only when the frontend is already Nuxt). Orchestrates the nuxt/vue/shadcn-vue/vueuse/pnpm skills with confirmation gates and real-world pitfall guidance.
